data.content:
* * *

## [Delivery experience has been terrible](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a21a1353b0fa7adbc1f56be)
Delivery experience has been terrible. Agreed on a delivery date and they but in a whole different date in the system. I had no idea they put a different date until the day before my expected deliver i questioned by I hadn’t recieved a delivery window timeframe yet. That when the rep told me I was not on the schedule for the day we agreed it a totally different day that week that does not work for me at all. When I explained this to the rep on the phone he was extremely nasty and just trying to hang up. This was not my mistake it was their and they did even apologize for the major inconvenience just rushed off the phone and told me to call back when I figure it out..

May 20, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 5, 2026

Hi Keith,

Thank you for sharing your experience with our freight carrier. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you encountered, and we will share your feedback with our shipping team to improve our processes in the future.

Lulu and Georgia
